### Victory Assured
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-13-2026.html
Passage: Revelation 16:17
Points:
- World events and increasing conflict can make evil appear victorious, but Christians must live by faith.
- A limited perspective can prompt panic, much like incomplete news arriving before final victory is announced.
- Christ has already defeated the enemy, and God's sovereign voice announces that the end is done.
- Believers must resist fear and remain alert, prepared, and faithful for the Lord's return.

### The Plague of Hail
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-plague-of-hail
Passage: Revelation 16:17-21
Points:
- The seventh bowl expands earlier warnings into an all-encompassing portrait of final judgment.
- Apocalyptic imagery illustrates a cosmic shaking that completely brings down world powers opposed to God.
- The alignment of worldly systems against the Lord proves to be their downfall when their head collapses.
- Severe suffering does not soften hardened sinners, who continue in obstinate rebellion without divine intervention.
- Believers are urged to pray that God grants unregenerate hearts the grace to believe.
